verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's Code Interpreter/Data Analysis capability (documented via file drafting, spreadsheet/PDF handling, interactive visualizations, and downloadable finished files) lets it write and execute code against uploaded data to produce charts and computed answers, then export results as documents/spreadsheets/PDFs. Docs explicitly describe analyzing files, building interactive visualizations, and downloading completed files, and community evidence corroborates real code/file execution capability (e.g., running code/containers, file interpretation plugins). Missing for 10: no dedicated first-party doc page specifically titled 'Code Interpreter/Data Analysis' in this pack, and no hands-on example showing a specific chart-from-CSV walkthrough.
